sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject. Preserve all prior instructions: applicability must be conditional on the authoritative thrusterBody-to-calculationCase relationship, using hasNaturalFrequencyCalculationCase without making unrelated components or ships universally applicable. Constrain the component as a thrusterBody and enforce the linked calculationCase vibrationDirection alternatives for the required longitudinal and transverse estimation directions without making mutually exclusive alternatives conjunctively mandatory.
